title: Each type in their first week at a new job
caption:
New job, new badge, sixteen ways to survive induction week.

One read the whole wiki on day one. One fixed the printer and became a legend. One knows everyone's coffee order by Tuesday. Swipe to find yourself.

The useful bit: introverts, book three one-to-one coffees instead of one big lunch. Extraverts, ask one question for every idea you pitch.

Send this to a friend starting a new job this month.
